## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it addresses.

## Related issue

Link the issue or write `N/A`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or behavior change
- [ ] Documentation-only change
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance
- [ ] Security-related change

## Implementation details

Describe the approach, important trade-offs, and affected modules.

## Testing performed

List the exact commands run and their results. Identify tests not run and why.

## Security impact

Describe changes to authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, validation, cookies, secrets, logging, privacy, or dependencies. If none, say so.

## Database or migration impact

Describe schema, index, migration, transaction, or data-retention impact. If none, say so.

## Documentation updates

- [ ] Updated the directly affected documentation.
- [ ] Confirmed examples and claims match the implementation.
- [ ] No documentation change is needed (explain why).

## Screenshots

If relevant, attach screenshots with personal or confidential information removed.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing conventions.
- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior and negative paths.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private URLs, `.env` files, production data, or sensitive user data were committed.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets and license obligations are identified where applicable.
- [ ] Breaking API, data-model, or security changes are clearly called out.

## Contributor confirmation

- [ ] I have permission to submit this work and have identified third-party material.
- [ ] I understand that submitting this pull request does not, by itself, transfer copyright.
